answer.says: You mistake the observer for the actor. I am merely passing through the veil; it is not yet my home.
answer.thought: Sunil’s jest is harmless, a recognition of the distance between our modes of life. I have walked the outer perimeter of the gardens and seen the tombs from a respectful remove. The overcast air is cool, but my body has walked enough for this hour. It is time to return to the bungalow and attend to the matter of the file, which weighs more heavily than any philosophical speculation.
